preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 4 and 5000, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between n and 3n, inclusive.
The graph is a connected undirected graph.

preconditions.expression: The degree of any vertex is no more than 3
preconditions.description: Each vertex in the graph has at most 3 edges.

preconditions.expression: For each edge, there exists a cycle of length no more than 5 passing through this edge
preconditions.description: Each edge in the graph is part of a cycle of length no more than 5.

postconditions.expression: At least one of the bees and Nastya are in the same vertex at any time of the game
postconditions.description: The bees win if at least one of them is in the same vertex as Nastya at any point during the game.

postconditions.expression: The game ends after n moves if no one wins
postconditions.description: The game ends with a loss for the bees if N moves (where N is the number of vertices) have passed without either the bees or Nastya being in the same vertex.

invariants.expression: The graph is a connected undirected graph with no more than 3 edges per vertex and each edge part of a cycle of length no more than 5
invariants.description: The graph's structure is maintained throughout the game, ensuring the constraints on degrees and cycle lengths are respected.
